original_test_intent: Validate the platform FIO_BD's I2C-visible inventory and health without guessing its acronym expansion, board revision, front-panel resource population or control semantics.
original_method: With only missing-spec placeholders, no BMC mux selection, bus scan or endpoint read is authorized. Engineering must define the physical board, connectors/devices, safe reads and observable acceptance before fresh review.
manual_activity: Platform/FIO owners must define the board revision and physical connector/device/indicator population, management route and safe response matrix before any bus access.
required_inputs: Authoritative FIO_BD definition, location and revision
Allowed identity/status reads and reserved controls
Expected endpoint, sensor and indicator state
safety_requirements: Do not assume a generic front-I/O device set
Do not probe unknown indicator/button/EEPROM/control endpoints
Do not issue force or write-capable transactions
Correlate any future logical read with physical/resource identity
Stop on FIO, indicator, sensor, BMC or bus anomaly
agent_execution_scope: Keep RIO and cable cases independent
Require fresh review after the spec
engineer_actions: Define safe registers and expected states
Specify any manual visual evidence and recovery

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The all-bus loop never selects FIO_BD or maps responders to physical connectors, indicators, sensors or controllers. It can touch unrelated management devices, suppresses errors and truncates evidence, so it cannot satisfy an absent board-specific criterion.

command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The literal FIO_BD scope and two-minute estimates remain unchanged; no front-panel component, address or state is assumed.

modernized_recommendation.status: PENDING FIO BOARD RESOURCE AND I2C CONTRACT
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Once approved, traverse only the documented BMC/OOB mux branch, read allowlisted identity/status fields for each named FIO resource and correlate logical responses with board revision, connector population, indicators/sensors and platform events.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Requires physical-resource mapping and a response oracle instead of generic presence scanning.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An address response cannot establish which FIO connector or device is present, whether its status is correct, or whether a physical indicator matches logical state.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some FIO endpoints may mix passive inventory with button, LED or other control registers; exact resource semantics and any manual observation must be approved before access.

project_override_considerations: Treat FIO_BD I2C as BMC/platform-management scope by default; require controller/mux/address, board resource mapping, vendor specification and expected output.
expected_evidence: Approved FIO_BD definition/specification and fresh review
Complete raw responses mapped to the FIO BOM/resources
Logical-to-physical indicator/sensor evidence when required plus BMC SEL/SDR/OS health
No state change, abort/recovery audit and owner verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master is not internally contradictory; it supplies no executable or evaluable content beyond a reference to an absent FIO specification.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Board identity, physical resource coverage, transaction safety and the pass oracle are all undefined. These are core semantics, not package or confirmation prerequisites.

engineering_decision_request.question: Define Functionality row 1807 Wistron-HW-00009-V003 I2C FIO_BD: authoritative FIO board function/location/revision and connector/device/indicator population, BMC/OOB owner and controller/mux/bus route, address/register allowlist, expected logical and any physical states, stop conditions and recovery; preserve Master placeholders and require fresh review.

review_improvement: Makes the FIO physical-resource map and any logical-to-physical evidence mandatory instead of accepting an unscoped presence scan.
independent_technical_reasoning: A front or other I/O board can host inventory EEPROMs, sensors, indicator drivers and control endpoints behind a mux. Address presence alone neither identifies the physical resource nor proves its state. Because the source provides no topology or criterion, the review cannot distinguish safe identity reads from operations that affect user-visible or management behavior.
